title: 第6897章 维度大劫第6896章 成功蜕变
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 璀璨的金色神光照耀四方。
即便此地乃是地府最为核心的酆都混沌，遍布无尽的死气，却也被那神光照耀的大气堂皇。
一时间，无数鬼哭神嚎的声音立刻响起。
不知道多少阴兵，鬼神，在神光的照耀之下，化作了云烟彻底消散。
强如阴天子，十方鬼帝乃至于六大鬼王，或多或少都受到了削弱。
看着九天之上的神剑，祂们的瞳孔之中都充斥着按捺不下去的震惊，依稀间还可以看到些许恐惧。
万万没有想到，如此绝境之下，竟然真的被孙冰找到了一线生机。
原本就顿感不妙的地府诸多强者，内心都浮现出一抹阴霾。
诸如骷髅王，阴魂鬼王等等诸多鬼王，更是不约而同暗骂一声：
“不仅那修罗鬼王是废物，连带着祂的兵器也是废物。”
只可惜无论此时祂们的心中乃是何等愤怒，却也没有挽回的余地了。
因为青萍剑以混沌灵宝之身，强行晋升，需要历经第五维度的考验。
放眼诸天万界，这可以说乃是第一个蜕变至混沌至宝的宝物。
所以其引发的声势相当浩大。
这一刻，整个酆都混沌的时空都陷入了静止。
仰头望去，赫然能够看见，天穹直接裂开，滚滚高维洪流倾泻而出。
更高维度的伟力席卷四方，强行镇压了一切，强如阴天子都无法行动分毫。
“这便是更高维度的伟力么？当真是可怕啊。”
感受到了这股恐怖的压迫，九黎大神，霸王等人的瞳孔之中，都闪过一抹感慨。
至于骷髅王，阴魂鬼王等存在，则浮现出一抹追忆。
犹记得无尽岁月之前，祂们同样也是纵横第五维度的顶尖强者。
可如今，自身完全就是阶下之囚。
而在诸多强者脑海思绪万千的时候，阴天子依旧没有放弃针对孙冰。
在更高维度的洪流下，任何低维的力量都无法掀起任何涟漪。
但千万不要忘了，阴天子本就是地府之主。
这酆都的混沌意志都在其掌控之中。
所以此时阴天子的目光锐利，暗中则全力命令混沌理智：
“动用一切权柄接引高维洪流，无论如何都要彻底摧毁此剑。”
如今青萍剑的蜕变已经成功，祂根本就没有办法阻挠。
恰好类似这等蜕变，需要历经第五维度的考验。
所以阴天子便想要借助这股力量，彻底摧毁青萍剑。
这乃是孙冰的证道至宝，一旦出现任何问题，连带着他本人都会受到不小的反噬。
到时候完全能够借此时机发动反击。
事情也正如阴天子所掌控的那般，在混沌意志的接引之下，汇集的高维洪流越来越多。
无尽的高维能量汇集，演化出了一片雷海。
此乃第五维度中，雷霆大道的本质，是真正的高维雷霆之道。
其中蕴含的能量无穷无尽，随意一道雷霆，都能够轻易泯灭一方混沌。
甚至仅仅只是此时散发的气息，就足以让所有生灵退避三舍。
九天之上，高维大道显化的雷海沸腾，无穷能量汇集，终究第一道雷霆彻底落下。
完全超出了任何低维所能想象的雷光爆发。
content_en:
The dazzling golden divine light shines in all directions.
Even though this place is the chaos of Fengdu at the core of the underworld, filled with endless death energy, it is still magnificently illuminated by the divine light.
For a time, countless cries of ghosts and howls sounded.
Countless evil soldiers, ghosts and gods turned into clouds and completely dissipated under the divine light.
As strong as Emperor Yin, the Ghost Emperors of the Ten Directions and even the six ghost kings have all been weakened to a greater or lesser extent.
Looking at the Divine Sword above the Nine Heavens, their pupils were filled with unbearable shock, and some faint fear could be seen.
He never expected that in such a desperate situation, Sun Bing would actually find a glimmer of hope.
Many powerful people in the underworld, who had already felt bad, felt a sense of gloom in their hearts.
Many ghost kings, such as the Skeleton King and the Ghost King, all cursed secretly:
"Not only is the Shura Ghost King useless, but his weapons are also useless."
It's a pity that no matter how angry they are in their hearts at this time, there is no room for recovery.
Because Qingping Sword is promoted as a Chaos Spiritual Treasure and needs to undergo the test of the fifth dimension.
Looking at all the worlds, this can be said to be the first treasure that has transformed into the treasure of chaos.
So the momentum it caused was quite huge.
At this moment, the entire chaotic time and space of Fengdu fell into stillness.
Looking up, one can suddenly see that the sky directly splits open, and a rolling high-dimensional torrent pours out.
The mighty power of a higher dimension swept across all directions and forcibly suppressed everything, even as powerful as Emperor Yin, who was unable to move at all.
"Is this the power of a higher dimension? It's really terrifying."
Feeling this terrifying oppression, a flash of emotion flashed across the pupils of Master Jiuli, Overlord and others.
As for the Skeleton King, the Ghost King and other existences, there is a hint of reminiscence.
I still remember that endless years ago, they were also the top powerhouses in the fifth dimension.
But now, he is completely a prisoner of his subordinates.
While the minds of many strong men were racing with thoughts, Yin Tianzi still did not give up targeting Sun Bing.
Under the torrent of higher dimensions, no low-dimensional power can cause any ripples.
But don't forget that Yin Tianzi is the Lord of the Underworld.
The chaotic will of Fengdu is under its control.
So at this time, Emperor Yin's eyes were sharp, and he secretly ordered Chaos Reason with all his strength:
"Use all your authority to lead the high-dimensional torrent and completely destroy this sword no matter what."
Now that Qingping Sword's transformation has been successful, there is nothing he can do to stop it.
Just like this kind of transformation, it needs to go through the test of the fifth dimension.
Therefore, Emperor Yin wanted to use this power to completely destroy Qingping Sword.
This is Sun Bing's ultimate treasure of enlightenment. Once any problem occurs, he himself will suffer considerable backlash.
At that time, we can take this opportunity to launch a counterattack.
Things are just as under the control of Yin Tianzi. Under the guidance of the will of chaos, more and more high-dimensional torrents are gathering.
Endless high-dimensional energy gathered and evolved into a sea of ​​thunder.
This is the essence of the Avenue of Thunder in the fifth dimension, the true way of high-dimensional thunder.
The energy contained in it is endless, and a random thunder can easily wipe out a party of chaos.
Even just the aura emitted at this time is enough to make all living beings retreat.
Above the nine heavens, the thunder sea manifested by the high-dimensional avenue boiled, infinite energy gathered, and finally the first thunder fell completely.
It is completely beyond the imagination of any low-dimensional lightning burst.
